# Certko

> Certko is a BIS certification and product compliance platform for India. Search 1,400+ notified products for IS standards, HSN codes, QCO status, marking fees, lab test cost ranges, and 400+ BIS-recognised laboratories.

Certko helps manufacturers, importers, and marketplace sellers understand which Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) certifications apply, what testing is required, indicative costs, and which labs can test a product. Contact: info@certko.com · +91-9999118039 · https://certko.com/contact

## Main pages

- [Home](https://certko.com/): BIS certification checker overview and product search
- [Products](https://certko.com/products): Browse notified product categories
- [Product search table](https://certko.com/products/all): Filter all products by IS, HSN, QCO status, scheme, fees and labs
- [Certifications](https://certko.com/certifications): BIS and related certification schemes
- [BIS certification](https://certko.com/certifications/bis): ISI / CRS schemes, process and products covered
- [Product testing](https://certko.com/testing): Lab testing categories and services
- [Labs](https://certko.com/labs): BIS-recognised testing laboratories directory
- [QCO tracker](https://certko.com/qco): Quality Control Order status and enforcement dates
- [Blog](https://certko.com/blog): Guides and updates on Indian product compliance
- [Contact](https://certko.com/contact): Get expert help on certification and testing
- [HTML sitemap](https://certko.com/sitemap): Human-readable list of main site sections
- [XML sitemap](https://certko.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable URL list for crawlers
